questions: Q1: What CLI files reference EXECUTE and need PLAY updates?
Q2: Is the CLI change safe to deploy independently?

answers.answer: Two files: (1) create.ts line 13 — VALID_MODES array, line 17 — help text. (2) cli-content.ts line 109 — mode documentation table. The mode validation logic (lines 79-88) normalizes to uppercase and checks includes() — no structural change, just swap EXECUTE for PLAY in the array and text.
evidence: src/docs/cli-content.ts:109 — mode list in docs table

answers.answer: Deploy server first. The CLI sends mode to POST /api/tickets — if PLAY is sent before the server knows PLAY, the server rejects with 400 (mode not in platformConfig.allowedModes). With server deployed first, CLI sending PLAY works immediately.
evidence: create.ts:147 — mode sent in POST body
ticket-controller.ts:152-154 — server validates mode against allowedModes

statement: CLI needs 2-file change: replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES (create.ts) and docs (cli-content.ts). Smallest change of all repos. Deploy server first to avoid 400 rejections. No new subcommands needed for L1. L2/L3 may add play-specific CLI commands (hlx plays list/preview/run) but those are deferred.
